verdict.rationale: Viam's docs describe the full loop. Captured data syncs to the cloud (viam-docs-7, viam-docs-51). Developers build and annotate datasets and train models in the cloud, with programmatic job submission through the ML Training Client API (viam-docs-8, viam-docs-61). Trained models are pushed back and pulled automatically by machines for local inference, with versioning, staging, canary testing, rollback and OTA model updates (viam-docs-9, viam-docs-26, viam-docs-48). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end retrain-and-redeploy loop, and in-depth docs beyond marketing-level summaries.
